scope: Offline diagnosis of existing candidates and test harness only; no product/spec/prompt/deployment changes, live recording, paid APIs or new endpoint candidates
frozen_inputs: Original 20 audio IDs/SHA/labels; original full ASR texts; all previously selected 256 LiveKit turns and original annotations. Existing result files are read-only.
repeatability: Three deterministic CPU passes on all original 20 audio files for Smart Turn, TurnSense INT8 and FP32, plus three CPU float32 passes on all 20 full ASR texts through the unchanged XTurnix listening pipeline. Report action changes and maximum score drift, separately from label accuracy. Do not rerun ASR or sample tokens.
trigger_audit: Compare the old every-200ms policy with its first 200ms observation, using existing predictions only. Separately feed the same 256 source WAVs through the unmodified Pipecat 0.0.102 SileroVADAnalyzer and default VADParams; call each endpoint candidate once on each actual VAD stop event. Use a source-time clock for the upstream five-second VAD state reset; never use labels to generate those events. Preserve 32ms frames and original EOF, without silence padding.
buffering: At the first VAD speech event, use the upstream 500ms pre-speech plus VAD start delay and official eight-second model preprocessing. Keep this turn until its first complete decision; later observations are shadow diagnostics, never successful delivery after a premature decision.
explicit_exclusions: Do not copy the upstream three-second forced-completion fallback or transcript delivery gate into Crabot. This audit tests VAD-triggered acoustic decisions, not a complete Pipecat conversation pipeline or product acceptance. No threshold, delay, labels or original failure samples are changed.
censoring: Record EOF without completion separately from failure within the existing 1.5s deadline. Classify no final VAD stop separately from model incomplete/invalid; do not invent missing future audio or count unobservable time as success.
label_review: Retain all original labels. Export annotated before/after words for every new premature pause and every 1-3s hold; these are source transcript inspection, not independent listening or proof that an ambiguous pause has a unique answer.
stop: One bounded repeatability run and one VAD replay of the frozen 256 turns. Preserve all errors. Finish with attribution and uncertainty; do not expand into another model search or ask the user to repeat tests. Any product design change requires separate confirmation.
